def: A device that gives light, usually with a bulb and a stand or shade.
有燈泡、通常附燈座或燈罩的照明裝置。
ex: A desk lamp would make the reading corner easier to use.
一盞檯燈會讓閱讀角更好用。
The lamp in the hallway has been flickering all week.
走廊的燈整個星期都在閃爍。
Please turn off the lamp before you lock the office.
鎖辦公室之前請先關掉檯燈。
The hotel room had a bedside lamp with a USB port.
飯店房間的床頭燈附有 USB 插孔。
The street lamps along the road come on at dusk.
沿路的路燈在黃昏時亮起。

note: General word for anything that gives light; a lamp is a device that holds a bulb.
泛指任何光源；lamp 是裝有燈泡的燈具。
A portable lamp with a protective case, often carried by hand.
有保護外罩、常可手提的燈，如燈籠。

def: A person or company that owns a building and rents it to others.
擁有建築物並出租給他人的人或公司。
ex: Our landlord agreed to repaint the office before we move in.
我們的房東同意在我們搬入前重新粉刷辦公室。
Contact the landlord if the heating stops working.
如果暖氣停了，請聯絡房東。
The landlord raised the rent by five percent this year.
房東今年把租金調漲了百分之五。
She paid the deposit to the landlord by bank transfer.
她用銀行轉帳把押金付給房東。
A landlord must give tenants notice before entering the unit.
房東進入租屋單位前必須先通知房客。

note: Formal legal term for the party that grants a lease.
正式法律用語，指出租契約中的出租方。

def: A narrow strip of road or track marked for one line of traffic or one swimmer.
為一列車流或一名泳者劃出的狹長道路或泳道。
ex: Traffic was slow because one lane was closed for repairs.
因為一條車道封閉維修，車流很慢。
Please stay in the right lane unless you are passing.
除非要超車，否則請保持在右側車道。
The pool has six lanes and is open to members in the evening.
游泳池有六條泳道，晚上開放給會員使用。
The city added a bike lane along the main avenue.
市府在主要大道旁增設了自行車道。
The airport opened a separate lane for priority passengers at security.
機場在安檢處為優先旅客另開了一條通道。

note: A line is a row of people waiting or a drawn mark; a lane is a marked strip for traffic or swimmers.
line 指排隊的人龍或畫出的線；lane 是供車輛或泳者使用的分隔道。

def: A small portable computer that you can use on your lap or a desk.
可放在腿上或桌上使用的小型攜帶式電腦。
ex: Please bring your laptop and charger to the training session.
請把筆電和充電器帶來參加訓練課程。
The company issues each new employee a laptop.
公司發給每位新進員工一台筆電。
My laptop battery lasts about eight hours.
我的筆電電池大約可用八小時。
She left her laptop in the taxi and called the driver.
她把筆電忘在計程車上，並打電話給司機。
Passengers must take their laptops out of their bags at security.
旅客在安檢時必須把筆電從包包裡拿出來。

note: Another word for a laptop, also written notebook computer; it also means a paper pad.
也指筆記型電腦（notebook computer）；notebook 另有紙本筆記本的意思。

def: The way the parts of a space, page or screen are arranged.
空間、頁面或畫面各部分的安排方式。
ex: The new office layout gives every team more space.
新的辦公室配置讓每個團隊有更多空間。
The designer sent us two layout options for the brochure.
設計師寄給我們兩種小冊子版面方案。
Check the floor plan to learn the layout of the exhibition hall.
請看平面圖了解展覽廳的格局。
We changed the layout of the store to improve customer flow.
我們更改了店內配置以改善顧客動線。
The website's mobile layout is hard to read.
這個網站的手機版版面很難閱讀。

note: More general; a layout is a specific arrangement of space or visual elements.
較籠統；layout 特指空間或視覺元素的安排。
Broader; design covers style and function, not only where things are placed.
範圍較廣，涵蓋風格與功能，不只是擺放位置。

def: A contract that lets someone use property for a fixed time in return for rent.
讓人在固定期間內使用房產並支付租金的契約。
ex: We signed a two-year lease for the new warehouse.
我們簽了新倉庫的兩年期租約。
The company leases its fleet of vans from a local dealer.
公司向當地經銷商租用整批廂型車。
The lease expires at the end of March.
租約在三月底到期。
Our office space is leased, not owned.
我們的辦公空間是租的，不是自己擁有。
Read the lease carefully before you pay the deposit.
付押金之前請仔細閱讀租約。

note: Everyday word for paying to use something; a lease is a formal contract for a fixed term.
日常用語；lease 指有固定期限的正式租賃契約。

def: The entrance hall of a building; also, to try to influence officials.
建築物的入口大廳；也指設法影響政府官員。
ex: Please wait for the visitor in the hotel lobby.
請在飯店大廳等候訪客。
The elevator lobby on the fifth floor is being repainted.
五樓的電梯廳正在重新粉刷。
Several industry groups lobbied the government to lower import taxes.
幾個產業團體游說政府降低進口稅。
Local business owners are lobbying for better parking downtown.
當地業者正在為市中心更好的停車環境進行游說。
A powerful lobby of farmers opposed the new law.
一個有力的農民遊說團體反對這項新法。

note: Entrance hall of a theatre, hotel or house; sounds a little more formal than lobby.
劇院、飯店或住宅的入口大廳；比 lobby 稍正式。

def: A symbol or design that a company uses to identify itself.
公司用來標示自己的符號或圖案。
ex: Our logo must appear in the top corner of every slide.
我們的標誌必須出現在每張投影片的左上角。
The designer is updating the company logo.
設計師正在更新公司標誌。
Staff wear shirts with the store logo on the pocket.
員工穿著口袋上印有店家標誌的襯衫。
Please send the logo as a high-resolution file.
請把標誌以高解析度檔案寄來。
The new logo will be printed on all packaging by June.
新標誌將在六月前印在所有包裝上。

note: A symbol that stands for an organization or country; more formal than logo.
代表組織或國家的象徵圖案；比 logo 正式。
A legal term for a registered name or symbol; a logo is only the design.
指經註冊的名稱或圖案的法律用語；logo 只是圖案設計。
A slogan is a short advertising phrase, not an image.
slogan 是簡短的廣告標語，不是圖像。

zh: 手冊、說明書；手動的、人工的
def: A book of instructions; also, done by hand rather than by machine.
說明操作方法的書；也指用手做而非靠機器的。
ex: Check the user manual before you contact technical support.
聯絡技術支援之前，請先查閱使用手冊。
The employee manual explains how to request vacation days.
員工手冊說明如何申請休假。
Packing the boxes is manual work, so we need extra staff.
裝箱是人工作業，所以我們需要額外人手。
The printer has a manual feed for special paper.
這台印表機有供特殊紙張使用的手動進紙孔。
The factory is replacing manual checks with automatic sensors.
工廠正在用自動感應器取代人工檢查。

note: A smaller reference book; a manual gives step-by-step instructions for using or doing something.
較小的參考書；manual 提供操作或做事的逐步說明。
To manufacture is to make goods in a factory; it only looks similar.
manufacture 指在工廠製造商品，拼寫相近但意思不同。

def: Newspapers, television, websites and other ways of spreading news and information.
報紙、電視、網站等傳播新聞與資訊的管道。
ex: The company sent a press release to the local media.
公司把新聞稿寄給當地媒體。
She manages our social media accounts.
她負責管理我們的社群媒體帳號。
The merger was widely covered in the media.
這樁合併案受到媒體廣泛報導。
We will use several media, including radio and print, for the campaign.
這次宣傳活動我們將使用包括廣播和平面在內的數種媒介。
Staff may not speak to the media without approval.
員工未經核准不得對媒體發言。

note: The press means news organizations, especially newspapers; media is wider and includes TV and online.
the press 主要指新聞機構，尤其是報紙；media 範圍更廣，含電視與網路。

def: The joining of two or more companies into one.
兩家以上的公司合併成一家。
ex: The two banks announced a merger on Tuesday.
兩家銀行在週二宣布合併。
After the merger, many employees moved to the new headquarters.
合併之後，許多員工搬到新總部。
Regulators must approve the merger before it can go ahead.
主管機關必須核准這項合併案才能進行。
A special team in our firm handles mergers and acquisitions.
我們公司有一個專門小組處理併購業務。
The merger will create the largest airline in the region.
這項合併將創造出該地區最大的航空公司。
coll: a merger between A and B
A 與 B 的合併

note: Formal; joining several things into one stronger whole, not always two companies.
較正式；指把多個單位整合成較強的整體，不一定只是兩家公司。
In an acquisition one company buys another; in a merger two companies join as one.
acquisition 是一家公司買下另一家；merger 是兩家公司合而為一。

def: A device that picks up sound and sends it to a speaker or recorder.
接收聲音並傳送到喇叭或錄音設備的裝置。
ex: Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear you.
請對著麥克風說話，讓大家都聽得到。
The microphone stopped working in the middle of the speech.
麥克風在演講中途故障了。
The technician tested every microphone before the conference began.
技術人員在會議開始前測試了每一支麥克風。
A wireless microphone allowed the presenter to walk around the room.
無線麥克風讓講者可以在會場裡走動。
Please mute your microphone when you are not speaking on the call.
通話時若不發言，請把麥克風靜音。

note: Informal short form of microphone, used in speech and casual writing.
microphone 的口語縮寫，用於口語和非正式文字。
A speaker plays sound out; a microphone picks sound up.
speaker（喇叭）把聲音播出；microphone 負責收音。

def: A short report of news sent regularly to members, staff or customers.
定期寄給會員、員工或客戶的簡短消息刊物。
ex: Our monthly newsletter includes updates from every department.
我們的月刊通訊收錄各部門的最新消息。
Subscribe to the newsletter to receive discount codes.
訂閱電子報即可收到折扣碼。
The HR team wrote an article about the new benefits for the company newsletter.
人資團隊為公司通訊寫了一篇介紹新福利的文章。
Please send your story ideas for the next newsletter by Friday.
請在週五前把下一期通訊的稿件構想寄來。
She unsubscribed from the newsletter because it arrived too often.
她因為電子報寄得太頻繁而取消訂閱。

note: A short official notice or report, often internal; a newsletter is longer and issued on a schedule.
簡短的官方公告或報告，常為內部使用；newsletter 篇幅較長，定期發行。
A newspaper is sold to the general public with daily news; a newsletter serves a specific group.
newspaper 向一般大眾販售每日新聞；newsletter 只服務特定群體。

def: Twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.
白天正中的十二點整。
ex: The deadline for applications is noon on Friday.
申請截止時間是週五中午十二點。
Lunch will be served at noon in the cafeteria.
午餐中午十二點在自助餐廳供應。
We plan to leave for the airport around noon.
我們打算中午前後出發去機場。
The store stays open until noon on Saturdays.
這家店週六營業到中午。
Please reply before noon so we can finalize the order.
請在中午前回覆，我們才能確認訂單。

note: Can mean the whole period around twelve o'clock; noon is exactly 12:00.
可指十二點前後的一段時間；noon 則是剛好十二點。

def: To tell someone officially about something, especially a change or event.
正式告知某人某事，尤指變更或事件。
ex: Please notify the front desk if you plan to check out early.
如果打算提早退房，請通知櫃檯。
We will notify you by email as soon as your package ships.
您的包裹一出貨，我們就會以電子郵件通知您。
The manager notified staff of the schedule change on Monday.
經理在週一通知員工班表有變動。
Customers will be notified of any delay in advance.
任何延誤都會事先通知顧客。
The bank notified him that his card had expired.
銀行通知他，他的卡已經過期。
coll: 透過電子郵件收到通知

note: More general; notify is more formal and usually concerns an official event or change.
較通用；notify 較正式，通常涉及正式的事件或變更。
Formal, used in business letters in the sense of telling someone; also means to give advice.
商業信函中的正式用法，意為告知；另有提供建議的意思。
Announce means to say something publicly; notify is aimed at particular people.
announce 是公開宣布；notify 是針對特定對象告知。

def: To get something, often by asking or by effort.
取得某物，常指經由申請或努力而得。
ex: You must obtain a permit before you start construction.
開工之前，你們必須先取得許可證。
Employees can obtain a parking pass from the security office.
員工可以向警衛室領取停車證。
We obtained the data from a government survey.
我們從政府的調查取得這些數據。
She obtained a loan to open a second shop.
她取得一筆貸款來開第二家店。
Tickets are hard to obtain during the festival.
慶典期間門票很難取得。

note: Everyday word; obtain is more formal.
日常用語；obtain 較正式。
Suggests gaining something over time or through effort, such as skills or a company.
暗指經過一段時間或努力才得到，如技能或公司。
To get something after effort or competition, such as a contract.
經過努力或競爭才取得，如合約。
Attain means to reach a goal or level, not simply to get an item.
attain 指達成目標或水準，不只是拿到某樣東西。

zh: 主辦者、籌辦人；整理收納用品
def: A person or group that plans and arranges an event; also, a tool for keeping things in order.
規劃並安排活動的人或團體；也指整理物品的用具。
ex: The organizer of the conference booked three meeting rooms.
會議的主辦人預訂了三間會議室。
Please ask the event organizer where to register.
請向活動主辦人詢問在哪裡報到。
The organizers expect about 500 guests.
主辦單位預期約有五百位賓客。
A desk organizer keeps pens and papers in order.
桌上收納盒能讓筆和紙張井然有序。
She is the lead organizer of the annual trade fair.
她是年度貿易展的總籌辦人。

note: Someone who plans things, such as events; organizer also suggests handling the arrangements.
負責規劃事情（如活動）的人；organizer 還暗指負責實際安排。
Manages how different people and activities fit together, often as a job title.
負責協調不同的人與活動，常作為職稱。

zh: 新進人員訓練、新生說明會；方向、取向
def: An introduction to a new job, school or place; also, a basic direction or focus.
對新工作、學校或環境的介紹；也指基本方向或重點。
ex: New employees attend an orientation on their first day.
新進員工在第一天參加新人訓練。
The orientation session covers safety rules and company policies.
這場說明會涵蓋安全規定與公司政策。
A tour of the building is part of the orientation program.
參觀大樓是新人訓練課程的一部分。
Students received an orientation packet at registration.
學生在註冊時領到一份新生說明資料。
Our training aims to build a stronger customer orientation.
我們的訓練旨在培養更強的顧客導向。

note: British term for the process of introducing a new employee to the job.
英式用語，指帶領新員工認識工作的過程。
Broader and longer than an orientation session; covers the first weeks in a new role.
比一場說明會更廣、更長；涵蓋新職務的最初幾週。

def: A period when power or a service is not working.
電力或服務無法運作的一段時間。
ex: A power outage shut down the entire office for two hours.
停電讓整間辦公室停擺了兩個小時。
The website suffered a brief outage on Monday night.
網站在週一晚上發生短暫中斷。
Customers were told to expect a service outage during the upgrade.
顧客被告知升級期間服務會中斷。
The network outage was caused by a damaged cable.
網路中斷是因為纜線受損。
The IT team restored service after a three-hour outage.
資訊團隊在中斷三小時後恢復了服務。

note: A total loss of electricity across an area; outage is wider and includes services.
整個地區完全停電；outage 範圍較廣，也含各種服務中斷。
The time a system is unavailable; often used for computers and machines.
系統無法使用的時間，常用於電腦與機器。
Outrage is strong anger, not a break in service.
outrage 是強烈的憤怒，不是服務中斷。

def: Done, used or found outside a building.
在建築物外進行、使用或存在的。
ex: The company picnic will be held at an outdoor park.
公司野餐會將在戶外公園舉行。
The store sells outdoor furniture and gardening tools.
這家店販售戶外家具和園藝工具。
Heavy rain forced us to cancel the outdoor concert.
大雨迫使我們取消戶外音樂會。
The hotel has an outdoor pool that closes at ten.
這家飯店有一座戶外泳池，十點關閉。
Please wear sturdy shoes for the outdoor team-building activity.
戶外團隊活動請穿堅固的鞋子。

note: Describes a place with no roof, such as a market or theatre; outdoor is the more general word.
形容沒有屋頂的場所，如市集或劇場；outdoor 較通用。

zh: 過夜的；隔夜的；一夜之間
def: Lasting or happening through the night; also, very suddenly.
持續或發生於整個夜間；也指非常突然地。
ex: We booked an overnight stay near the airport.
我們在機場附近訂了一晚住宿。
The parcel will arrive overnight if you choose express shipping.
選擇快遞運送的話，包裹會隔夜送達。
She took an overnight flight to London for the meeting.
她搭夜間班機去倫敦開會。
Leave the samples in the fridge overnight.
請把樣品放在冰箱裡過夜。
The company did not become successful overnight.
這家公司不是一夜之間成功的。

def: A person who paints walls and buildings as a job, or who paints pictures.
以粉刷牆壁和建築物為業的人，或繪畫的人。
ex: The painter will start on the lobby walls on Monday.
油漆工週一會開始粉刷大廳的牆面。
We hired a painter to repaint the meeting rooms.
我們請了一位油漆工重新粉刷會議室。
The gallery is showing works by a local painter.
這間畫廊正在展出一位本地畫家的作品。
A professional painter finished the whole floor in two days.
一位專業油漆工兩天內就粉刷完整層樓。
The painter asked us to move the furniture before he arrived.
油漆工請我們在他到達前先把家具移開。

note: British term for someone who paints and wallpapers rooms.
英式用語，指替房間上漆、貼壁紙的人。

def: The ability to wait calmly or deal with problems without getting upset.
能冷靜等待或處理問題而不心煩的能力。
ex: Thank you for your patience while we fix the problem.
感謝您在我們修復問題期間的耐心等候。
Dealing with complaints requires a great deal of patience.
處理客訴需要非常大的耐心。
He lost his patience after waiting an hour for the repair.
等了一小時的修理後，他失去了耐心。
The airline asked passengers for patience during the delay.
航空公司在延誤期間請旅客多多包涵。
She showed great patience with the anxious customer.
她對焦急的顧客表現出極大的耐心。

note: Patients are people receiving medical care; the plural of patient, not the same as patience.
patients 是接受治療的病人（patient 的複數），與 patience 不同。

def: Required to be paid, or able to be paid, at a stated time or to a stated person.
須在指定時間或對指定對象支付的。
ex: The invoice is payable within thirty days of receipt.
這張發票須在收到後三十天內付款。
Please make the check payable to Hartman Supplies.
請把支票的受款人開成 Hartman Supplies。
Accounts payable will process your claim next week.
應付帳款部門下週會處理您的申請。
A deposit of 20 percent is payable upon booking.
預約時須支付百分之二十的訂金。
The fee is payable by credit card or bank transfer.
費用可用信用卡或銀行轉帳支付。

note: Due stresses the date by which payment is expected; payable stresses to whom, when or how it is paid.
due 強調付款期限；payable 強調付給誰、何時或如何支付。

zh: 薪資發放作業、薪資名單
def: The list of employees a company pays, or the process of paying them.
公司所支付薪資的員工名單，或發放薪資的作業。
ex: The payroll department sends salary slips on the last day of the month.
薪資部門在每月最後一天寄出薪資單。
The company has 200 employees on its payroll.
這家公司的薪資名冊上有兩百名員工。
Please report any payroll errors to HR within five days.
任何薪資錯誤請在五天內向人資通報。
We use new payroll software to calculate overtime.
我們使用新的薪資軟體來計算加班費。
The firm cut costs by taking forty people off the payroll.
這家公司把四十人從薪資名單中移除以削減成本。

note: A paycheck is what one person receives; payroll is the whole list or system.
paycheck 是個人拿到的薪資；payroll 是整份名單或整個發薪系統。

def: A doctor who is trained and licensed to treat illness.
受過訓練並領有執照、可治療疾病的醫生。
ex: Please consult your physician before starting a new exercise program.
開始新的運動計畫前，請先諮詢您的醫師。
The company physician examines employees once a year.
公司醫師每年替員工做一次檢查。
She works as a physician at the city hospital.
她在市立醫院擔任醫師。
A physician must sign the medical certificate.
診斷證明必須由醫師簽名。
Your primary care physician can refer you to a specialist.
您的基層醫療醫師可以轉介您給專科醫師。

note: Everyday word; physician is more formal and used in official or medical contexts.
日常用語；physician 較正式，用於官方或醫療情境。
A physicist is a scientist who studies physics, not a medical doctor.
physicist 是研究物理的科學家，不是醫生。

zh: 作品集；投資組合；產品組合
def: A collection of work samples, investments or products shown or managed together.
一併展示或管理的作品樣本、投資或產品的集合。
ex: Applicants should bring a portfolio of their recent design work.
應徵者應攜帶近期設計作品集。
The fund manager reviews the investment portfolio every quarter.
基金經理人每季檢視投資組合。
Our portfolio includes hotels in twelve countries.
我們的產品組合包含十二個國家的飯店。
She built an online portfolio to show her photography.
她建立了線上作品集來展示她的攝影作品。
The bank has a diverse loan portfolio.
這家銀行的放款組合相當多元。

def: To move an event to a later time.
把活動改到較晚的時間。
ex: We had to postpone the meeting because the manager was ill.
因為經理生病，我們必須延後會議。
The launch has been postponed until next month.
發表會已延到下個月。
Heavy snow forced the organizers to postpone the outdoor concert.
大雪迫使主辦單位延期舉辦戶外音樂會。
Can we postpone the interview until Thursday?
我們可以把面試延到週四嗎？
They decided to postpone hiring until the budget is approved.
他們決定等預算核准後再招聘。

note: Can be unplanned; postpone means deliberately moving something to a later time.
可能是非預期的；postpone 是刻意改到較晚的時間。
Informal phrasal verb with the same meaning; postpone is more formal.
意思相同的口語片語動詞；postpone 較正式。
To set a new time; it can also mean moving earlier, whereas postpone only means later.
指訂出新時間，也可以提前；postpone 只能延後。
Formal; often used for decisions, payments and studies.
較正式；常用於決定、付款和學業。
Cancel means the event will not happen; postpone means it will happen later.
cancel 是取消不辦；postpone 是之後再辦。

def: An extra amount paid; a regular payment for insurance; of higher quality.
額外支付的金額；保險的定期費用；品質較高的。
ex: The monthly insurance premium will rise by ten percent.
每月保險費將調漲百分之十。
Customers pay a premium for rooms with a sea view.
顧客要為海景房多付一筆溢價。
We offer premium service to members of the loyalty program.
我們為忠誠計畫的會員提供高級服務。
The shop sells premium coffee beans from Colombia.
這家店販售來自哥倫比亞的高級咖啡豆。
Seats near the stage are sold at a premium.
靠近舞台的座位以較高的價格出售。

note: Describes top-quality and expensive products; premium is a label sellers give to an upper tier.
形容頂級且昂貴的產品；premium 是賣方給較高等級的標示。
Luxurious; often used for hotel rooms and special editions of products.
豪華的；常用於飯店房型和商品特別版。
Premier as an adjective means leading or best; it is not the same as premium.
premier 作形容詞指首要的、頂尖的，與 premium 不同。

def: To say officially that something must not be done.
正式規定某事不可做。
ex: Company policy prohibits employees from accepting gifts from clients.
公司政策禁止員工收受客戶的禮物。
Smoking is prohibited anywhere in the building.
大樓內任何地方都禁止吸菸。
The contract prohibits us from sharing the data with third parties.
合約禁止我們與第三方分享這些資料。
The new rule prohibits drivers from parking at the loading dock.
新規定禁止駕駛人把車停在裝卸碼頭。
Photography is strictly prohibited inside the museum.
館內嚴禁攝影。

note: Shorter and common in news; often a ban imposed by an authority.
較簡短，常見於新聞；多半是由權責機關下的禁令。
Everyday word, often used when a person with authority says no.
日常用語，常用於有權威者說不可以。
Inhibit means to slow down or hold back; it does not mean to ban.
inhibit 是減緩、抑制，不是禁止。

def: A machine that shows images or slides on a screen or wall.
把影像或投影片顯示在螢幕或牆上的機器。
ex: The projector in Room 3 is not working.
三號會議室的投影機壞了。
Please connect your laptop to the projector before the meeting starts.
會議開始前，請先把你的筆電接上投影機。
We need to order a new bulb for the projector.
我們得為投影機訂購新燈泡。
A ceiling-mounted projector shows the slides on a large screen.
吊掛在天花板上的投影機把投影片投在大螢幕上。
The IT staff set up the projector and a screen in the hall.
資訊人員在大廳架設了投影機和螢幕。

def: To prepare and print or post something so the public can read it.
製作並印行或發布內容，讓大眾能閱讀。
ex: The company will publish its annual report on the website.
公司將在網站上公布年度報告。
Her article was published in a leading business magazine.
她的文章刊登在一本知名的商業雜誌上。
The firm publishes travel guides for more than twenty countries.
這家公司出版超過二十個國家的旅遊指南。
Please do not publish the figures until the board approves them.
董事會核准之前，請不要公布這些數字。
Our newsletter is published on the first Monday of each month.
我們的通訊在每月第一個週一發行。

note: To make something available to the public, such as a report or a product.
把報告或產品等公開提供給大眾。
Formal; an organization officially puts out a statement or document.
較正式；機構正式發出聲明或文件。
Publicize means to make something widely known, as in advertising; it does not mean to print.
publicize 是廣為宣傳（如廣告），不是印刷出版。

def: Happening or produced four times a year, once every three months.
一年發生或發行四次，每三個月一次。
ex: The finance team prepares a quarterly report for the board.
財務團隊為董事會準備季度報告。
Rent is paid quarterly, not monthly.
租金是按季支付，而不是按月。
Our quarterly sales exceeded forecasts for the third time in a row.
我們的季度銷售額連續第三次超出預期。
The committee meets quarterly to review the budget.
委員會每季開會一次來檢討預算。
Please submit the quarterly tax payment by the fifteenth.
請在十五日前繳交季度稅款。

def: A partial refund of money paid, given after a purchase or payment.
購買或付款之後退還的一部分款項。
ex: Customers can claim a rebate of fifty dollars on this printer.
顧客購買這台印表機可申請五十美元的退款優惠。
The tax rebate arrived in my account last week.
退稅款上週匯入了我的帳戶。
Send the receipt with your form to receive the rebate.
請把收據連同表格寄來以取得回饋金。
The manufacturer offers a rebate on all new refrigerators in May.
製造商在五月對所有新冰箱提供退款優惠。
The supplier gives a volume rebate on orders above 1,000 units.
供應商對一千件以上的訂單提供量大回饋。

note: A discount lowers the price at the time of purchase; a rebate returns money afterwards.
discount 是購買當下降價；rebate 是事後退還款項。
A refund returns all or most of what you paid, usually after a return or cancellation.
refund 退還全部或大部分已付款項，通常是在退貨或取消之後。

def: A paper or message showing that money or goods have been received.
證明已收到款項或貨物的單據或訊息。
ex: Please keep your receipt in case you need to return the item.
請保留收據，以便需要退貨時使用。
The accountant asked for a receipt for every expense.
會計要求每筆支出都附上收據。
Payment is due within ten days of receipt of the invoice.
款項須在收到發票後十天內付清。
We confirmed receipt of your application by email.
我們已用電子郵件確認收到您的申請。
The clerk printed a receipt and put it in the bag.
店員印出收據並放進袋子裡。

note: An invoice asks for payment; a receipt confirms that payment was made.
invoice 是要求付款；receipt 是證明已付款。
Recipe means cooking instructions; the p in receipt is silent and the words are not related.
recipe 是食譜；兩者意思無關。

zh: 接待櫃檯；歡迎會；反應；收訊
def: The place where visitors are greeted; also, a formal party, a response, or signal quality.
接待訪客的地方；也指正式的歡迎會、反應或訊號品質。
ex: Please leave your bag at reception and sign the visitor book.
請把包包留在接待處並在訪客簿上簽名。
The hotel reception is staffed around the clock.
飯店櫃檯二十四小時有人值班。
A welcome reception will be held in the ballroom at six.
歡迎酒會將於六點在宴會廳舉行。
The new product got a warm reception from buyers at the fair.
這項新產品在展覽會上受到買家熱烈歡迎。
Mobile phone reception is poor in the basement.
地下室的手機收訊很差。

note: More common in American English for the hotel or office counter where guests check in.
美式英語較常用，指飯店或辦公室供客人報到的櫃檯。
Receipt is a proof of payment; the two words look alike but are unrelated in meaning.
receipt 是付款證明；兩字外形相近，意思無關。

def: A person whose job is to greet visitors and answer calls at an office, hotel or clinic.
在辦公室、飯店或診所負責接待訪客、接聽電話的人。
ex: Please give your name to the receptionist when you arrive.
到達時請把姓名告訴櫃檯接待人員。
The receptionist directed the visitors to the third floor.
接待人員指引訪客前往三樓。
We are hiring a part-time receptionist for the dental clinic.
我們正在為牙醫診所招聘一名兼職櫃檯接待人員。
The hotel receptionist arranged a taxi to the station.
飯店櫃檯人員安排了前往車站的計程車。
She started as a receptionist and is now the office manager.
她從櫃檯接待做起，現在是辦公室經理。

note: American term for hotel staff who check guests in and out.
美式用語，指替旅客辦理住退房的飯店人員。
A secretary does administrative work for a manager; a receptionist greets visitors and answers the phone.
secretary 替主管處理行政事務；receptionist 負責接待訪客和接電話。

def: To process used materials so they can be made into new products.
處理使用過的材料，使其能製成新產品。
ex: All staff are asked to recycle paper and plastic bottles.
全體員工被要求回收紙張和塑膠瓶。
The company recycles old computers instead of throwing them away.
公司把舊電腦回收，而不是丟棄。
These boxes are made from recycled cardboard.
這些箱子是用回收紙板製成的。
Please recycle this brochure when you finish reading it.
讀完這本小冊子後，請將它回收。
Water used in the factory is recycled and reused on site.
工廠使用的水經過回收後在現場再利用。

note: To use something again as it is; recycling turns used material into something new.
原樣再次使用；recycle 則是把用過的材料製成新東西。
To use something for a new purpose without breaking it down.
不經拆解而改作新用途。

def: To plan and make something again with a new design.
以新的設計重新規劃並製作。
ex: The team will redesign the website to make it easier to use.
團隊將重新設計網站，讓它更好用。
The redesign of the lobby will take about six weeks.
大廳的重新設計大約需要六週。
We hired an agency to redesign our logo and packaging.
我們請了一間公司重新設計標誌和包裝。
The bag was redesigned after customers complained about the zipper.
顧客抱怨拉鍊之後，這款包包重新設計了。
A complete redesign of the app is planned for next spring.
應用程式預計在明年春天全面改版。

note: A thorough change to a system or structure, not only its appearance.
對系統或結構的徹底改造，不只改外觀。
Informal; to make something look or work like new.
較口語；使某物煥然一新或運作更新。

def: Money paid back to a customer who returns goods or cancels a service.
顧客退貨或取消服務時被退還的款項。
ex: You can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase.
購買後三十天內可以申請全額退款。
The airline will refund your ticket if the flight is cancelled.
如果航班取消，航空公司會退還您的機票款。
I am writing to ask for a refund for the damaged item.
我來信是想為受損的商品申請退款。
The shop refunded the full price without asking questions.
這家店沒有多問就退還了全額款項。
Refunds are paid back to the original card within seven working days.
退款會在七個工作天內退回原付款的信用卡。

note: Everyday phrasal verb for returning money; refund is the formal word used by sellers.
歸還錢款的日常片語動詞；refund 是賣方使用的正式說法。
Reimburse means to pay back costs someone spent for you, such as work expenses; a refund returns a customer's payment.
reimburse 是補還別人替你花的費用，如公務開銷；refund 是退還顧客付款。

def: To pay back money that someone has spent or lost.
歸還別人已花費或損失的錢。
ex: The company will reimburse you for travel expenses.
公司會補償你的差旅費用。
Please attach receipts so we can reimburse your costs.
請附上收據，我們才能報銷你的費用。
She was reimbursed for the taxi fare within a week.
她的計程車費在一週內就獲得報銷。
Employees can be reimbursed for training courses related to their jobs.
與工作相關的訓練課程費用，員工可以申請報銷。
The insurer will reimburse the full cost of the repairs.
保險公司會補償全部修理費用。

note: To pay back money, often borrowed; reimburse is for costs someone paid on your behalf.
歸還款項，常指借款；reimburse 指補還別人代你付的費用。
To give money for loss, damage or extra work; it is broader than paying back a cost.
為損失、損害或額外工作給予金錢；範圍比補還費用更廣。
A seller refunds a customer's payment; an employer reimburses an employee's expenses.
賣方 refund 顧客的付款；雇主 reimburse 員工的開銷。

def: Money paid back to someone for an amount they spent or lost.
歸還給某人其已花費或損失的金額。
ex: Submit your reimbursement request by the fifth of each month.
請在每月五日前提出報銷申請。
Reimbursement usually takes about two weeks.
報銷通常要花大約兩週。
She is waiting for reimbursement of her hotel bill.
她正在等待飯店費用的報銷。
A receipt is required for any reimbursement over twenty dollars.
超過二十美元的報銷都需要附收據。
The form for travel reimbursement is on the intranet.
差旅報銷的表格放在內部網站上。

note: General word for paying back money, including loans; reimbursement covers costs paid on someone's behalf.
歸還款項的通用字，含貸款；reimbursement 針對代人支付的費用。
A refund comes from a seller to a customer; reimbursement usually comes from an employer or insurer.
refund 來自賣方給顧客；reimbursement 通常來自雇主或保險公司。

def: To make pain, worry or pressure less strong.
使疼痛、憂慮或壓力減輕。
ex: The new software should relieve the pressure on the support team.
新軟體應該能減輕客服團隊的壓力。
Taking a short walk can relieve stress during a busy day.
忙碌的一天裡，短暫散步可以舒緩壓力。
We were relieved to hear that the shipment had arrived safely.
聽到貨物安全抵達，我們鬆了一口氣。
Extra staff were brought in to relieve the night shift.
公司調來額外人手接替夜班。
The medicine relieves pain within thirty minutes.
這種藥在三十分鐘內可以緩解疼痛。

note: To make pain or pressure less severe; a plain, common word.
使疼痛或壓力減輕；簡單常用的字。
Formal; to reduce pain, hardship or a problem without removing it completely.
較正式；減輕痛苦、困難或問題，但未完全消除。
Relive means to experience something again in memory; it is not about easing pain.
relive 是在記憶中重新經歷；與減輕痛苦無關。

def: The move of a business or person to a new place.
企業或個人遷到新的地點。
ex: The relocation of our head office to Taichung begins in June.
我們總公司遷往台中的作業在六月開始。
The company offers a relocation package to staff who move abroad.
公司為調往國外的員工提供搬遷補助方案。
Relocation costs include shipping furniture and temporary housing.
搬遷費用包括運送家具和臨時住所。
A relocation to the new warehouse will reduce delivery times.
搬到新倉庫將縮短配送時間。
Employees were notified of the factory's relocation two months in advance.
員工在兩個月前就被告知工廠要搬遷。

note: Everyday word; relocation is formal and used for businesses and staff moving to a new place.
日常用語；relocation 較正式，用於企業或員工遷往新地點。
Usually an employee being sent to another office; it may not involve moving house.
通常指員工被調到另一個辦公室，不一定要搬家。
Location is a place, not the act of moving.
location 是地點，不是搬遷這個動作。

def: Not wanting to do something and slow to agree.
不想做某事而遲遲不肯答應。
ex: Many customers are reluctant to share their personal details online.
許多顧客不願意在網路上提供個人資料。
He was reluctant to leave his job without another offer.
沒有別的工作機會，他不願意辭掉現職。
The manager was reluctant to approve the extra budget.
經理不太願意核准額外預算。
She gave a reluctant nod and signed the agreement.
她勉強點了點頭，簽下協議。
After a reluctant start, the team accepted the new schedule.
起初不太情願，後來團隊接受了新的時程。

note: Stronger; an unwilling person may refuse, while a reluctant person often still agrees.
語氣較強；unwilling 的人可能拒絕，reluctant 的人往往最後還是同意。
Unsure and slow to act; reluctant adds that the person does not want to do it.
不確定而遲疑；reluctant 還帶有不想做的意思。

def: The part that is left after the rest has been used, taken or dealt with.
其餘部分用掉、取走或處理之後剩下的部分。
ex: We will deliver the remainder of the order next week.
我們下週會送出訂單的其餘部分。
Please pay the remainder of the balance by the end of the month.
請在月底前付清剩餘款項。
The remainder of the budget will go to staff training.
預算的剩餘部分將用於員工訓練。
She spent the remainder of the day answering emails.
她把當天剩下的時間都用來回電子郵件。
Only half the seats were filled, and the remainder stayed empty.
只有一半的座位坐滿，其餘都是空的。
coll: for the remainder of the year

note: Everyday word, as in the rest of; remainder is more formal.
日常用語，如 the rest of；remainder 較正式。
The amount of money still owed or left in an account.
尚欠或帳戶中剩下的金額。
A reminder is something that helps you recall a task; a remainder is what is left over.
reminder 是幫助想起的提示；remainder 是剩下的部分。

def: Something that helps a person recall a task, date or fact.
幫助人記得要做某事或想起某事的東西。
ex: I sent a reminder to all staff about the Friday deadline.
我寄了提醒信給全體員工，告知週五的截止期限。
The system sends an automatic email reminder the day before each appointment.
系統在每次預約的前一天自動寄出電子郵件提醒。
This is a friendly reminder that your invoice is overdue.
謹此提醒，您的發票款項已逾期。
The poster is a reminder to wash your hands.
這張海報是在提醒大家洗手。
Set a reminder on your phone so you do not miss the call.
在手機上設定提醒，才不會錯過通話。

note: A remainder is the part that is left; the two words look alike.
remainder 是剩下的部分；兩字外形相近。

def: The act of making something valid or active again for a further period.
使某物在另一段期間內再度有效或運作的行為。
ex: Please apply for passport renewal at least a month before your trip.
請在旅行前至少一個月申請護照換發。
The contract is up for renewal in September.
合約將在九月到期續約。
We will send you a renewal notice before your membership expires.
會員資格到期前，我們會寄給您續約通知。
Urban renewal has brought new shops and offices to the old district.
都市更新為老城區帶來了新的商店和辦公室。
Automatic renewal can be turned off in your account settings.
自動續約可以在帳號設定中關閉。

note: Extra time added to an existing period; a renewal starts a new term.
在現有期間上加時間；renewal 則是開始新的一期。
Renovation is repairing and improving a building; the words look alike.
renovation 是修繕並改善建築物；兩字外形相近。

def: To repair and improve an old building or room so it looks new.
修理並改善舊建築或房間，使之煥然一新。
ex: The hotel will close in March so it can renovate all the rooms.
飯店三月將暫停營業，以便整修所有客房。
We plan to renovate the kitchen in the staff lounge.
我們打算整修員工休息室的廚房。
The old factory was renovated and turned into an office building.
舊工廠經過整修，改成了辦公大樓。
The owner spent a year renovating the historic building.
屋主花了一年整修這棟歷史建築。
They renovated the lobby to give it a modern look.
他們翻新了大廳，讓它有現代感。

note: To clean, redecorate and repair so a place is in good condition again.
清潔、重新裝飾並修理，使場所恢復良好狀態。
To change the structure or layout of a room or building; common in American English.
改變房間或建築的結構或格局；美式英語常用。
Renew means to make valid again or to replace; renovate is for buildings and rooms.
renew 是使重新有效或更換；renovate 用於建築物和房間。

def: Work done to repair and improve a building so it looks new.
修理並改善建築物使其煥然一新的工程。
ex: The museum is closed for renovation until the end of the year.
博物館因整修而休館，直到年底。
Renovations to the lobby will start next Monday.
大廳的整修工程將從下週一開始。
The cost of the renovation was higher than we first estimated.
整修費用比我們一開始估計的還高。
The apartment needs major renovation before anyone can move in.
這間公寓需要大規模整修才能入住。
Guests may hear some noise because of renovation work on the third floor.
因為三樓正在整修，住客可能會聽到一些噪音。

note: British; cleaning, decorating and repairing a place to bring it back to good condition.
英式用語；清潔、裝飾並修繕場所使其恢復良好狀態。
American; changing the structure or layout of a room or building.
美式用語；改變房間或建築的結構或格局。
Renewal means making a contract or document valid again; the words look alike.
renewal 是使契約或文件重新有效；兩字外形相近。
Innovation is a new idea or method, not building repair.
innovation 是新的想法或方法，與建築修繕無關。
